checkedAlternates.risk: Fusion splices join two fibers like connectors.
checkedAlternates.resolution: A fusion splice permanently melts glass ends together (group-1), unlike pluggable physical connectors (group-4).

checkedAlternates.risk: Fiber Bragg Gratings are written directly inside a fiber core.
checkedAlternates.resolution: FBGs function as wavelength-selective passive filters/sensors (group-3), not general fiber transmission classes (group-2).
